title: Ledger compression
goal: The ledger is stored as deflate-raw + Base64 via the native CompressionStream and verifies exactly like JSONL.
scope: Header enc "deflate-raw+b64"; async boot without flashing empty content
Save compresses; old enc "jsonl" files keep opening
Hashes over canonical events, independent of encoding
Fallback to jsonl if CompressionStream is missing

rules.rule: The hash chain is independent of the encoding.

criteria: jsonl ↔ deflate round trip gives bit-identical canonical events and an equal hash on all targets.
Old jsonl fixtures open on all targets.
10k-word doc ≤ 150 KB; load ≤ 400 ms desktop, ≤ 1.5 s mobile.
Corrupted Base64 shows the integrity banner without an exception.
